_comment: Canonical inventory of every public URL in v1 scope. `key` is a filesystem-safe slug used to name baseline artifacts; `path` is the live/candidate path (identical on both sites — URL parity is a hard requirement). `dynamic` lists CSS selectors whose content legitimately differs between the live site and the WP build (graduates gallery, testimonials, recent-blogs rail, rendered dates) and must be MASKED in visual diffs. `expectedDivergence`, when present, marks a page whose content INTENTIONALLY differs from the live golden master — its visual diff is recorded but is NOT a parity failure (the visual runner annotates these and excludes them from the pass/fail count). Edit this file to add/remove pages; every runner reads it.

pages.title: Home
pages.expectedDivergence: graduates-empty-state: home shows 'NO GRADUATES YET' (0 seeded) vs live's populated rail. EXPECTED-pending-content — re-measure once real graduate photos are seeded.

pages.title: Services
pages.expectedDivergence: real-page-vs-dead-baseline: live /services is the feature-flagged dead surface (redirects to home content); the WP build correctly ships the REAL services page (Choose Your Path + 4 license-class tabs 7L/7N/5/4, real $100-$620 pricing). Per PLAN.md §1 + source-gotchas. Validate the real page structurally; the diff vs the live home-mirror is intended.

pages.title: Instructors
pages.expectedDivergence: real-page-vs-dead-baseline: live /instructors is the feature-flagged dead surface (renders home content); the WP build correctly ships the REAL instructors page (Meet Your Instructors + Why Choose Our Instructors + shared rail). Per PLAN.md §1 + source-gotchas.

pages.title: Blog Index
pages.expectedDivergence: net-new-content: 15 posts (5 live-matching originals + 10 new SEO articles) vs live's 5. Taller index + more pagination is intended additive content.
